lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说什么？

lines.en: : {i}I'm still impressed at how quickly you recovered from that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你从那件事里恢复得这么快，我还是挺佩服的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You know, it's a lot harder to cry when you're in a room full of girls staring at you and feeling bad for you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道吗，当你待在一屋子女孩中间，她们全都盯着你、为你难过的时候，反而很难哭出来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I honestly felt like my heart had dropped into like...my shoe.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说实话我当时感觉心脏像是掉进了……鞋子里。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which then made walking really hard but yeah.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}然后路都走不稳了，不过算了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}No bueno, Sensei. Zero total buenos.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}糟透了，Sensei。一点都不好。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, I think that not turning it into more of a thing is a sign of maturity and I'm proud of you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，我觉得你没把它闹得更大，是成熟的表现，我为你骄傲。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Thanks, Dad. You're always looking out for me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢了，老爸。你总是这么照顾我。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hold on, let me call my moms really quick and see if they'll let you into the family for real.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等等，我先给我妈们打个电话，看看她们愿不愿意正式让你进我们家。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Only downside is that I think Otoha hates them for some reason because they're lesbians and that's bad???{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}唯一的缺点是，我觉得 Otoha 不知为什么讨厌她们，因为她们是女同性恋，而这很糟糕？？？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don't really think that's what Otoha was implying.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得 Otoha 想表达的大概不是这个意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Probably not. I kinda zoned out because of the heart-shoe.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概不是。我当时有点走神，因为心掉进鞋子里了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And also because I thought she was about to dump me. Which, if she did, I'd probably grow another heart just so THAT one could fall into my other shoe.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还因为我以为她要甩了我。要是她真甩了我，我大概会长出另一颗心脏，好让那颗也掉进我另一只鞋子里。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why do you keep talking about shoes?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你为什么一直在说鞋子？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just got new ones. Thank you for asking.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我刚买了新鞋。谢谢关心。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anyway, yeah. Parents suck and I'm cool.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之，是啊。父母真讨厌，我还挺酷的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just not cool enough to show to parents if you know what I mean.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}只是还没酷到能带去见家长，你懂我意思吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Fucking vaginas man. If only I could just grow a penis whenever I wanted.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}操蛋的阴道啊。要是我能想什么时候长出阴茎就什么时候长就好了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I am very glad that you can not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我很庆幸你不能。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Me too. I probably wouldn't come to school anymore because I'd be busy messing around with it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也是。不然我大概就不来学校了，光顾着玩它了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}They seem really wiggly and fun.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}它们看起来又软又会扭，很有意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Weird, for sure. But still wiggly and fun.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是挺怪的，没错。但还是又软又会扭，很有意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay, I think that's a good stopping point for now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好了，我觉得今天就聊到这儿吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you gonna go wiggle your penis?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你要去扭你的阴茎了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yup. You got me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对。被你猜中了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay! Have fun, Sensei =X{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好！玩得开心，Sensei =X{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Wiggle that weiner good.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好好扭你的那根香肠吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Have things gotten any better since then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}从那之后情况有好转吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}They...haven't gotten any worse?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}算是……没有变得更糟？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which I guess is almost as good as getting better.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想这差不多也跟变好一样了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Just not really.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}只是其实并没有。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Like, Otoha still won't let me anywhere near her parents but at least she knows she's being a fucking asshole about it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}比如，Otoha 还是不让我靠近她父母，但至少她知道自己在这件事上是个混蛋了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's just like...I don't get how you can knowingly be an asshole and not really STOP being an asshole about the thing you're being an asshole about.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就像是……我不明白一个人怎么可能明知道自己在当混蛋，却还是不为自己当混蛋的那件事停下来。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That's so many assholes, Sensei. SO MANY ASSHOLES.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}混蛋也太多了，Sensei。混蛋太多了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well that took a turn.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，这话题转得可真快。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yeah I'm sorry /rant{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，抱歉 /吐槽完毕{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Anyway, how's your day?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之，你今天过得怎么样？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You find out your significant other is embarrassed to date you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这是问我发现自己的另一半羞于跟我交往吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We're not done, are we?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们还没聊完呢，是吧？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You bet your fuckin burrito we're not done{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你他妈说得太对了，我们还没完{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Idc if I have to frickin' go over to her house and hold a boombox over my head like in that one 80's movie.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}就算我得跑到她家门口、像那部八十年代电影里那样把 boombox 举过头顶，我也不在乎。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Do you know where I can get a boombox btw? Do they even sell those anymore?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}对了，你知道哪儿能弄到 boombox 吗？那玩意儿现在还有得卖吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Have we moved on or do you want to complain about your girlfriend a little more before we talk about boomboxes?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们是换话题了，还是你想再抱怨一会儿你女朋友，然后再聊 boombox？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}She's lucky she's so fucking hot because IF SHE WASN'T I woulda been like okay peace bye and then like dropkicked her or something{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她运气好，长得他妈的那么正，不然我早就 OK 拜拜了，然后大概再给她来个飞踢什么的{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But I kinda want to kiss her a lot more because she tasted really good and it was hot{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但我又更想吻她了，因为她尝起来很好，而且很性感{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Man, girls are the worst. Especially the girls that think girls shouldn't date girls. Like....they're GIRLS. Have you ever SEEN girls?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}天哪，女生最讨厌了。尤其是那些觉得女生不该跟女生交往的女生。拜托……她们可是女生啊。你到底有没有见过女生？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}They're so cute!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她们太可爱了！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I want to say I'm having a hard time following you right now, but I think I get it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我本想说我现在有点跟不上你，但我觉得我懂。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Girls really are just cute.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}女生真的是很可爱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sensei, has anyone ever told you you'd make a good lesbian?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei，有没有人说过你会是个很好的女同性恋？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Nope.{/i}
: {i}Is it because of your weiner?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是因为你的香肠吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Probably, Rin.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大概吧，Rin。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, I think you would be good, Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过我觉得你会很棒的，Sensei。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Keep it up.{/i}
: {i}Thank you?...{/i}
: {i}ANYWAY, g2g. Otoha and I have couples counseling. And by couples counseling I mean we're going to talk about music on the phone and pretend there's not a rift in our relationship.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}总之，我得走了。Otoha 和我要做情侣咨询。所谓情侣咨询，就是我们会通个电话聊音乐，然后假装我们之间没什么裂痕。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But thanks for asking. I appreciate it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过还是谢谢关心。我很感激。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Being a lesbian sounds really hard.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当女同性恋听起来真难。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I mean, we're technically bi. We're just in a lesbian relationship.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}严格来说我们是双性恋。只是我们处在一段女同性恋关系里。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It really sucks what happened at the Christmas party, but I can kind of understand the sentiment.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}圣诞派对上发生的事真的很糟糕，但那种心情我多少能理解。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You better have a really good follow up to that one buddy{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你最好能给出一个特别好的下文，哥们{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I just also understand what it's like to not really be able to tell others about a relationship.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是也理解那种“没法跟别人说自己在谈恋爱”是什么感觉。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Which girl is it and how long has it been Ayane{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是哪个女孩，多久了，Ayane{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm speaking in general terms. I'm not in a relationship like that with anyone.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我只是泛泛而谈。我没有跟任何人处在那种关系里。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I don't speak emoji.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不会说颜文字。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay here let me translate. The first one says lolsure and the second one also says lolsure, but in a more sarcastic and funny kind of way.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧，我来翻译一下。第一个的意思是“呵呵好吧”，第二个也是“呵呵好吧”，不过语气更讽刺、更好笑一点。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Yaaaay what a great time to remind me you hooked up with my first love.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}太好了，真是提醒我和我的初恋上过床的好时机。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That's...not exactly what I was going for.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我……本来不是想说这个的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well that's where you went and now I have to picture it for the rest of the night.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}反正你已经说到那儿了，现在我一整晚都得去想象那个画面。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You know I'm sorry, right.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道我很抱歉的，对吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's whatever. I'll just try and wash it out with thoughts of Otoha and hope you don't show up to fingerbang her in my fantasy either.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}无所谓。我就用 Otoha 的念头把它冲掉，希望在我的幻想里你也别冒出来用手指插她。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What I was really trying to say is that it's a really...human issue. And that it might be good try and see things from Otoha's perspective.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我真正想说的是，这是个很……人之常情的问题。试着站在 Otoha 的角度看问题，也许是件好事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you being serious{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是认真的吗{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, she's not planning on doing this forever, is she?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，她又不打算永远这样下去，对吧？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}She probably just needs some time to prepare them.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她大概只是需要点时间来做准备。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Prepare them for what?? I'm a girl, not fucking Cthulu.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}准备什么？？我是个女孩，又不是他妈的克苏鲁。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Don't get me wrong, being Cthulu would be pretty fucking sweet, but there's nothing she should have to prepare them for.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别误会，当克苏鲁确实挺他妈的酷，但她根本没什么好让他们准备的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Telling them she's dating a girl should be no harder than telling them she's dating a boy and I hate that I have to deal with this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}告诉他们她在跟一个女孩交往，不该比告诉他们她在跟一个男孩交往更难，而我讨厌自己还得应付这种事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well I hope you don't have to deal with it much longer.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，我希望你不用再应付太久。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Me too. It's hard.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我也是。这很难。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I need a hug.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我需要一个拥抱。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Come hug me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}过来抱我。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I can't right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我现在不行。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Later then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那晚点？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}We'll see.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再说吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Fine...{/i}
: {i}But it better be a good one. Not one of those half assed Sensei hugs you always give.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}但那个拥抱得好好的。别又像你平时那样敷衍了事地抱一下。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That's...just how I do it, though.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那……就是我抱人的方式啊。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Not anymore it's not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}从今往后就不是了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}See you later Sensei =){/i}
lines.zh: : {i}回头见 Sensei =){/i}
